name: 02 Daemon and store
intro: The per-user daemon and its store: starting, stopping and the service; the store and journal; jobs; dispatch and assignment life cycles; the inbox and nudges; generations and fencing; effects; reconciliation; leaders on demand; and recovery. One question comes from a silence in the sources; everything else is stated as already decided. When you accept it I commit it and start 03 Provider sessions and terminals.
notes: Rule 7: AssemblyAI#7 says every start restores the leaders, written when every leader ran all the time. Under AssemblyAI#14's leaders on demand, the draft restores Coordination and every leader whose role has open work.

Rule 43: AssemblyAI#9's command list gives `asmai effect` to workers only. AssemblyAI#18 and ADR 0007 later have the delivering leader record the PR it opens as an effect, so 09's guard will let the delivering leader record effects too.
Rule 21 leaves when each kind of job ends to 06, which owns delivery, so the rule is stated once.
The silence timeout, drain timeout and automatic-retry count are listed here because rules here use them, and in 07, which owns the operating limits; 09 gives every field's name once.
The socket's path and the name of the session-credential variable are left to implementation: no ticket decides them, and nothing depends on them beyond the ASMAI_ prefix.
